name: PSCD-GS (Perception-Structure Collaborative Densification)
definition: An extension of 3DGS adaptive density control that introduces a continuous perception–structure role representation to guide densification, cloning/splitting selection, and split placement, replacing single-score methods with complementary perceptual and structural cues.
summary: PSCD-GS is a 3D Gaussian Splatting densification strategy that replaces single-score heuristics with continuous perception and structure role representations to guide cloning and splitting.
